title: One shared dialog component, not a hand-rolled backdrop per feature
statement: A modal/dialog surface is built once as a shared component and reused; a feature does not add its own `<div class="...-backdrop">` plus bespoke open/close signal wiring when an existing dialog pattern already does the same job.
rationale: This is the operator-observed defect class: no component reuse. `app.html` currently defines the same backdrop-plus-panel structure independently three times (`guideline-dialog`, `repository-dialog`, `agent-studio-dialog`), each with its own `(click)="...set(false)"` handler and its own CSS. A focus trap, escape-to-close, or `aria-modal` fix has to be applied three times and will drift.

good.caption: Target shape: one shared dialog component owns backdrop, focus and close behavior.

bad.code:
...
...
...
bad.caption: Three independent hand-rolled backdrops in the same template.
